title: Cyberleek claims leak of 209 GB Xbox build of GTA 6; unverified
what_changed: Date changed from 20 November (DonanimHaber's article) to 19 November, when VGC reported the group's claimed release. Added VGC as a source; the summary now attributes the 209 GB size to DonanimHaber only and adds VGC's report that Take-Two has filed subpoenas to Discord. Status stays claimed, severity 1.
